unresolved.required: Verified nonzero b5q physical DRAM description or a separately reviewed runtime source for chosen/dram-base and chosen/dram-size
unresolved.why_window_is_insufficient: boot_args PhysicalBase/MemorySize describes kernel-owned allocation; gDramBase/gDramSize classifies physical DRAM, including framebuffer. Substituting the allocation window can classify a real DRAM framebuffer as Device memory.

qemu_control.scope: Control: original unmodified XNU, QEMU-known physical RAM range 0x40000000+4GiB, candidate config, synthetic framebuffer; not Samsung DRAM values
